versions.content: At SoAd_TcpAccepted(), SoAd shall perform the following actions if the TCP SoAd SocketConnectionGroup related to SocketId has both Specification of Socket Adaptor AUTOSAR CP R19 - 11 23 of 147 Document ID 416 : AUTOSAR_SWS_SocketAdaptor - AUTOSAR confidential - SoAdSocketTcpInitiate and SoAdSocketMsgAcceptanceFilterEnabled set to FALSE and is not online (i.e. current connection state not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE): (1) assign the TcpIp socket used for the established connect ion and provided as parameter SocketIdConnected to the socket connection and (2) change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE and return E_OK .

At SoAd_TcpAccepted(), SoAd shall perform the following actions if the TCP SoAd SocketConnectionGroup related to SocketId has both SoAdSocketTcpInitiate and SoAdSocketMsgAcceptanceFilterEnabled set to FALSE and is not online (i.e. current connection state not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE): (1) assign the TcpIp socket used for the established connect ion and provided as parameter SocketIdConnected to the socket connection and (2) change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE and return E_OK .

At SoAd_TcpAccepted (), SoAd shall perform the following actions if the TCP SoAdSocketConnectionGroup related to SocketId has both SoAdSocketTcpInitiate and SoAdSocketMsgAcceptanceFilterEnabled set to FALSE and is not online (i.e. current connection state not SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE ): 1. assign the TcpIp socket used for the established connection and provided as parameter SocketIdConnected to the socket connection and 2. change the state of the socket connection to SOAD_SOCON_ONLINE and return E_OK .
